The '''Crozwon Catapult''' was a type of maneuver that could be used in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter combat]].

==History==
The Crozwon Catapult was named after [[Crozwon]], a teacher at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] attempted to use the maneuver while in combat with [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].
